title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At long last, the day of the Japanese Derby has come. Mejiro Ardan expresses her gratitude for my support through every step of the journey.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Declaring that she'll win me the title of Derby trainer, she presses on to the stage where the decisive battle is to take place.
